name: Formula 3000

features.text: All-purpose cleaner for automotive and industrial uses.
Can be used on any surface not adversely affected by water.

description: An all-purpose cleaner for interior or exterior use on machinery, floors, walls, engines, tires and vehicle bodies. Quickly loosens and emulsifies grease and grime so that they may be easily rinsed away.
application: Light-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:40 with water. Medium-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:8 with water. Heavy-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:4 with water. 1) Dilute with water and apply with spray bottle or sponge. 2) Spray or wipe diluted solution on surface to be cleaned. 3) If needed, scrub surface with a brush or mop. 4) Rinse surface with clean water. Test for compatibility with aluminum, magnesium and painted surfaces before applying.
